_note: The widget data sources (plan 4.2, D79): what a binding {{source.field}} can read. tools/widget_check.py checks bindings against it; tools/gen_sources.py makes shell/widgethost/SourceCatalog.js from it. A field's type: text, number, fraction (0 to 1, for progress), boolean, numbers (a list of numbers, newest last: a chart's `values`), list (of items with the fields in `item`; a listRow that binds into one repeats per item), or open (any path below it: the source's own JSON). A source's options go in the widget's `sources` object (widgets/spec.schema.json).

clock.description: The time and date, updated every minute (every second while `seconds` is bound).

time.description: The time in the locale's short format, e.g. 14:05.

date.description: Weekday, month and day, e.g. Tue, Nov 3.

dayProgress.description: How much of the day has passed.

status.description: Charging, Discharging, Full or Not charging.

timeLeft.description: Time to full or to empty, e.g. 2 h 10 min; empty when unknown.

system.description: Processor, memory, swap, disk (/), network and uptime, read every second (option `every`, 0.5 to 10 s); histories keep the last `history` samples (60 when not given) for charts.

cpuName.description: The processor's name, e.g. AMD Ryzen 5 7600 (from /proc/cpuinfo, without trademarks and core count).

cores.description: Each processor core's use in percent.

cpuFrequency.description: The fastest core's clock, e.g. 4.2 GHz.

cpuHistory.description: Processor use in percent, the last samples.

memoryUsedGB.description: Memory in use in GB, for a pie chart.

memoryHistory.description: Memory in use in percent, the last samples.

disk.description: The root file system's use in percent.

diskUsedGB.description: Used, in GB, for a pie chart.

download.description: Receiving, e.g. 1.2 MB/s (every network but loopback).

downloadHistory.description: Receiving in KB/s, the last samples.

uploadHistory.description: Sending in KB/s, the last samples.

uptime.description: Time since start, e.g. 3 h 12 min.

load.description: Load average over one minute, e.g. 0.52.

gpu.description: A graphics card, every second (option `every`); AMD, Intel, nouveau and NVIDIA (through nvidia-smi), each giving what its driver reports: amdgpu's sysfs, or nvidia-smi when installed. The card the `card` option names (e.g. card1), else the one with the most video memory. A field the card does not report is missing.

name.description: The card's name, e.g. AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT (amdgpu.ids, pci.ids or nvidia-smi; the vendor and PCI id without them).

usageHistory.description: Use in percent, the last samples.

vram.description: Video memory in use in percent.

vramUsed.description: Video memory in use, e.g. 4.2 GB.

vramUsedGB.description: Video memory in use in GB, for a pie chart.

powerHistory.description: Power draw in watts, the last samples.

clock.description: The graphics clock, e.g. 2.61 GHz (600 MHz below 1 GHz).

sensors.description: Temperatures from every hwmon sensor, every second (option `every`), and the processor's power from RAPL when this user may read it (usually root only: then cpuPower is missing).

cpu.description: The processor's temperature in °C (k10temp, zenpower or coretemp).

cpuHistory.description: The processor's temperature, the last samples.

nvme.description: The first NVMe drive's temperature in °C.

temperatures.description: Every sensor with a plausible reading.

name.description: The driver and label, e.g. k10temp Tctl.

countdown.description: Time left until a moment (options: target, and from for the fractions).

text.description: What is left, e.g. 3 days 4 h, or Now.

remaining.description: Share of the time from `from` to `target` still left (0 without `from`).

progress.description: Share of the time from `from` to `target` gone (1 without `from` once done).

media.description: What is playing (MPRIS): the player that is playing, or else the first one.

art.description: Album art, a URL for heroImage.

weather.description: Current weather from Open-Meteo (no key), every 30 minutes; the place from the options or from Settings > Widgets.

wind.description: Wind speed with its unit, e.g. 12 km/h.

symbol.description: A Material Symbols name for the condition, e.g. partly_cloudy_day.

calendar.description: Upcoming events from an .ics file or a folder of them (vdirsyncer's); single events only, repeats are not expanded.

events.description: The next events, soonest first, at most 8.

date.description: Its day, e.g. Thu, Nov 5, or Today.

time.description: Its start time, or All day.

next.description: The next event's title, or No events.

count.description: How many events are in the coming days.

http.description: A JSON document from a URL that Settings > Widgets allows (option url; every `every` seconds, at least 60). Its fields are read below http, e.g. {{http.rates.EUR}}.

files.description: A text file (option path; read again when it changes).

text.description: The whole text, up to 2000 characters.

json.description: The file's JSON, when it is JSON, e.g. {{files.json.total}}.
